cadence_basis.reference: NXP MCF54418 Reference Manual, SSI registers and DMA request behavior
cadence_basis.confidence: The service period follows the proven 32-frame / 48 kHz geometry. SSI1 ownership and the complete interrupt chain are proven; the bootloader-established SSI1 input frequency/divider remains open.

implementation: A dedicated virtual timer models SSI1 TX FIFO demand every 666667 ns and services eDMA54. The stock channel-54 ISR acknowledges that DMA completion and software-forces source 63; QEMU no longer directly forces source 63 in continuous mode. Type-8 remains independent.
decision: The emulator sustains the native SSI1/eDMA54/firmware-force chain at the candidate 32-frame / 48 kHz cadence while producing nonzero host PCM and accepting later UI input. Keep the clock opt-in until the inherited SSI1 clock input is recovered.

next_gate.name: AR172_QEMU_SSI1_CLOCK_INPUT_GATE
next_gate.objective: Recover the bootloader-established CCM CDRH SSI1 divider and SSI_CLKIN/PLL frequency so the 48 kHz frame rate is register-derived rather than geometry-derived.

github_actions.policy: Validate locally and publish with [skip ci].

safety: All execution and capture remained local. No firmware, extracted MAIN, project data, factory sample names, or proprietary PCM are included.
